39776.title: Peking Opera Blues
39776.overview: In 1913 Beijing, three fierce women—disguised rebel Tsao Wan, jewel-seeking Sheung Hung, and opera heiress Pai Niu—embark on a daring quest filled with intrigue and betrayal, challenging societal norms amidst political turmoil and the vibrant world of Peking Opera.

285024.title: Heaven Knows What
285024.overview: A young heroin addict roams the streets of New York to panhandle and get her next fix, while her unstable boyfriend drifts in and out of her life at random.

887520.title: The Feast of the Wolf
887520.overview: The wolves are returning to a barren region in the Croatian-Dalmatian hinterland. Though the tourist destinations of the Adriatic coast are less than half an hour away, people in the deserted villages of Bukovica believe that "Brussels" represents evil and flies the wolves over by helicopter. Ana, a dedicated veterinarian, attempts to refute these theories and engage with the people on the ground.
887520.trailerName: The Feast of the Wolf / Trailer

949536.title: Kill Code
949536.overview: North America has been divided into four main quadrants. A power-hungry corporation has taken over the conventional prison system and made criminals the new law enforcers.  The owner of that corporation, nanoscientist Eion Prescott, created a nano-virus called Onyx. Which is distributed through deadly watches to criminals. First, infecting them. Then, forcing them into eliminating each other for freedom. Who can topple the corporation's entire system from within?

999136.title: Do Not Enter
999136.overview: A group of young explorers investigates an old abandoned hotel, only to encounter a strange supernatural being and a competing group looking for a legendary hidden treasure.

1037600.title: Miss Match
1037600.overview: Bong Soo loses his memories from an accident, which disables him to recognize his family. Due to this condition, and his ever-increasing odd behaviors, his relationships get mixed up. He treats his wife as his daughter and mistakes her daughter for a friend. Ironically, his friends and family start to accept the situation as they derive some comfort and warmth from it.

1046304.title: 9 Temples to Heaven
1046304.overview: A family of 9 takes their grandmother on a merit-making trip to 9 temples in 1 day, hoping to prolong her life. But the trip takes an unexpected turn.

1057888.title: Dry Leaf
1057888.overview: Lisa, a photographer, has gone missing. The last known detail is that she had been photographing rural football stadiums in villages across Georgia. Her father, Irakli, sets out to search for her, traveling from place to place. Levani, Lisa's best friend – and an invisible person – also sets off to help.

1087328.title: Dissident
1087328.overview: In 1960s Ukraine, at a time when many in the Soviet Union and Eastern Bloc were re-evaluating the socialist system, Oleg is a former soldier in the Ukrainian Insurgent Army that fought against both Nazi Germany and the communist Soviet Union for Ukrainian independence during World War II. After an amnesty deal is reached, Oleg is released from prison camp and returns to Ukraine, where he tries but fails to find his place in peacetime society.

1137888.title: The Man with the Bag
1137888.overview: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

1138528.title: Bad Fairies
1138528.overview: An original musical comedy that follows a delightfully subversive gang of fairies as they shake up their magical world.

1166688.title: Amoeba
1166688.overview: In a repressive city-state, a tomboy schoolgirl persuades three classmates at an all-girls school to rebel by forming a triad gang.
1166688.trailerName: Amoeba by Tan Siyou - Trailer - TIFF Discovery 2025

1214368.title: Golmaal 5
1214368.overview: Get ready for another rollercoaster of laughter with the iconic gang.
1214368.trailerName: Golmaal 5 Shoot Begins | Rohit Shetty | Ajay Devgn | Akshay Kumar | Rohit Shetty Picturez

1242528.title: Lima, la gris
1242528.overview: With his 20th birthday just around the corner and the constant fear of not knowing which direction to take in his life, Lau will reflect with his friends on the cloudy streets of Lima City while figuring out what he will do.

1263904.title: Sleep No More
1263904.overview: Two sisters deal with the sudden death of their mother at a wig factory. One believes it was suicide while the other is certain it was a result of possession and takes a job at the factory to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, their brother - born with an eerie gift to regenerate his own body - catches the attention of a ghostly figure roaming the factory, searching for a vessel to inhabit.

1276704.title: 53 Sundays
1276704.overview: When three siblings agree to meet and discuss their aging father's future, their reunion spirals into bickering, bantering and reliving old grudges.

1287520.title: November 1963
1287520.overview: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.

1306400.title: Merrily We Roll Along
1306400.overview: Franklin Shepard is a talented Broadway composer who abandons his theater career and all his friends in New York in order to produce films in Los Angeles. The story begins at the height of his Hollywood fame and moves backwards in time, showing snapshots of the most important moments in Frank’s life that shaped the man he is today. (A live recording of the 2024 Tony Award-winning Broadway revival of Stephen Sondheim and George Furth's musical, filmed at the Hudson Theatre in New York City.)

1318304.title: Once More
1318304.overview: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

1319520.title: Human Resource
1319520.overview: Working in HR at a challenging company, Fren interviews young new hires and is secretly one month pregnant, grappling with the decision to have a child in difficult circumstances.

1365664.title: Wei Baba
1365664.overview: A woman introduces her Chinese dad to her American Jewish boyfriend and manipulates their language barrier to keep everyone happy.

1380512.title: This Is Not Happening
1380512.overview: Bartek learns that his teenage son is the perpetrator of a murder at school. The distraught boy runs to his dad, so the man hides out with him in his fiancée's flat. As he tries to get everything under control, he grows up to confront the truth about his son and himself as a father.

1383136.title: Drift
1383136.overview: Over the course of a single night, a convoy of cars carries intimate conversations on the representation of Black bodies in France.

1390944.title: Five Stars
1390944.overview: A retired veteran finds transitioning into civilian life tough, when a woman with a big problem enters his RideShare begging the question, can you really escape fate?

1396640.title: Once Upon a Time in a Cinema
1396640.overview: Earl Clancy, a cinema owner on the edge, battles a series of disasters while juggling personal turmoil and the chaos of a packed Friday night crowd. Told in real time over the course of the movie playing in the cinema (Breathless, starring Richard Gere).
1396640.original_title: Once Upon a Time in a Cinema

1413728.title: Art of Destruction
1413728.overview: We follow the story of The Thinker bombing at the Cleveland Museum of Art, trying to solve the mystery behind it because no one was ever caught. By following this case, we unravel the whole landscape of Cleveland and the USA in the 60s/70s - student protests, social justice movements, anti-war movements, and radical militant groups. We give a context to the bombing, which is symbolic on so many levels - it's an art piece that randomly became a target for political violence that, by being left unrepaired, became a reminder of the complicated history of the 60s/70s. The Thinker is a silent witness to this fascinating decade, looking down from his pedestal, still thinking about our place in the world as humans.

1433568.title: The Rope Curse 4: Kuntilanak
1433568.overview: A forbidden exorcism is livestreamed in Indonesia, awakening the legendary female spirit Kuntilanak. What begins as an online spectacle quickly turns deadly. In Taiwan, Mila watches the ritual—and becomes the curse’s first victim. Soon, mysterious deaths and violent possessions follow. When Yulan collapses and is found to have lost part of her soul, it becomes clear that this is not an isolated incident, but a transnational curse. Seeking answers, Mila’s son returns her ashes to Indonesia, hoping to uncover the truth behind her death. Instead, he steps into a nightmare rooted in ancient folklore and unresolved hatred. As supernatural violence escalates, the group realizes that once Kuntilanak is summoned, the curse will not stop—until it claims everything in its path.

1436192.title: Sarvagunn Sampann
1436192.overview: Play by the book in the day and re-define it by night, what makes a perfect woman?
1436192.trailerName: Sarvagunn Sampann | Official Teaser | Hindi Zee 5 Original Film | Vaani Kapoor | Coming Soon

1439584.title: Ugly Story
1439584.overview: Follows a man who becomes obsessively attached to a girl in love with someone else, descending into a dark psychological state as he struggles with rejection, leading to dangerous consequences.
1439584.trailerName: Ugly Story - Official Trailer | Nandu, Avikagor | Pranava Swaroop | Shravan Bharadwaj

1448224.title: Vanya
1448224.overview: Vanya doesn't know his father. His mother says he works in Moscow. With friend Fedya, Vanya meets Viktor, his mother's former classmate who lived in Germany, wondering if he's Vanya's dad as they prepare to search for him in Moscow.

1462368.title: These Violent Delights
1462368.overview: Juliet awakens from a fever dream. How did we get here? The lines between hallucination and memory blur as cinema and dance collide in a kaleidoscopic journey of queer belonging, defiance, and self-discovery. A vivid retelling of Shakespeare’s Romeo and Juliet brought to life by Scottish Ballet.

1464544.title: Sender
1464544.overview: After receiving a series of packages containing unnervingly personal items, a woman tumbles down a paranoid rabbit hole to find her mysterious sender.

1476000.title: Summer Lost
1476000.overview: A man attempts to keep his terminal illness a secret while attending a wedding, but an unexpected romance reshapes his future as well as his past.

1476128.title: The Accompanist
1476128.overview: Emily accidentally tells her school nurse that her dementia-stricken grandpa almost got them killed, a rookie child-welfare agent is sent to their house to investigate. A botched extraction ensues and Emily is taken and placed with Sylvia, a new foster parent.

1476832.title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
1476832.overview: A teacher in an abusive marriage takes a job at a maximum security prison, where she falls for a charismatic inmate. The disastrous consequences call into question not only the nature of punishment and retribution, but the very limits of our humanity.
1476832.original_title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd

1477152.title: Torniquete
1477152.overview: After moving with her mother into her grandmother’s house, Amanda survives a violent robbery that leaves a scar on her face. Ridiculed for her appearance, she finds both her home and neighborhood turning against her. When she finally decides to face her wound, she and her family embark on a journey of healing and emotional growth, confronting the pain that has marked them inside and out.

1477664.title: Unraveled
1477664.overview: Maria is a former elite swimmer and famous sports commentator whose life unravels when her beloved husband Mikael, her former coach and father of their daughter, is suddenly suspected of sexual abuse. Sparking the scandal and media interest is the revelation in an upcoming book, of a young girl’s misguided infatuation for her swimming coach, with rumors suggesting that Mikael is the man in question.

1478048.title: Last Night in Sorrento
1478048.overview: Jack and Olivia marry and move from London to Sorrento, Italy, the couple’s new life begins to unravel as tensions lead to addictions and temptations. Family secrets are revealed, and the couple must accept that their lives will never be the same.

1480608.title: Lapönia
1480608.overview: Two sisters reunite in Lapland for Christmas, but chaos erupts when one niece tells her cousin Santa isn't real. The revelation triggers a family clash over truth versus childhood magic, revealing hidden secrets.

1480672.title: One Minute to Midnight
1480672.overview: As he is about to separate from his partner, with whom he lives in Eastern France, 49-year-old Léo learns of the death of his biological father whom he never knew. Before traveling to Italy to deal with the inheritance, he spends a few days in Paris to take stock of his life. Between conversations with his activist daughter and encounters with ghosts from his past, he begins to question his very existence, and, above all, his relationships with women.

1492640.title: UNABOMBER
1492640.overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

1493024.title: Il Bene Comune
1493024.overview: A tour guide and a failed actress accompany four inmates to the Pollino massif, in search of the centuries-old Bosnian pine, a symbol of resilience. The journey quickly becomes a journey of transformation, filled with encounters and changes, punctuated by a music that takes shape step by step, becoming a collective voice capable of bringing together diverse bodies, emotions, and stories. In a harsh yet beautiful landscape, punctuated by unexpected solidarity, fragments of complex lives emerge, along with open wounds and a profound need to be seen and heard. Talking, singing, and naming what has been experienced becomes a way to release tensions and rediscover a sense of belonging, at least until a sudden event calls everything into question. Because, sometimes, sharing one's story is already a first step toward something bigger.

1496928.title: We Are Aliens
1496928.overview: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

1504608.title: Something Casual
1504608.overview: Alex, a first-generation latino artist, and Frankie, a professional dancer, navigate the soulless casual hookup culture of Los Angeles. Dating apps and casual sex reign, as they both deny their feelings and continue seeing other people while they fall in love. A series of misunderstandings leaves these two star-crossed lovers oscillating between confusion (ghosting and ignoring) and obsession (sex and pasta). But what happens when they finally meet someone different? Do they even know how to love anymore?

1506208.title: TRAD
1506208.overview: From their home in the Donegal Gaeltacht, gifted fiddle player Shóna McAnally and her little brother Mickey take to the road with a troupe of wandering musicians, on a cross-country journey of adventure, romance, and musical exploration.

1510304.title: Donkey Days
1510304.overview: Sisters Anna and Charlotte have always fought for their mother’s attention. As old wounds reopen and suck them back to their family home, they unravel mesmerizing mysteries, including anonymous ashes and their mother’s love for a donkey. Will they come to terms with each other?
1510304.trailerName: Donkey Days | Trailer | New Directors/New Films 2026

1512480.title: Vanishing Point
1512480.overview: Lux searches for the eraser he needs to fix his drawing, but when his attempts to get his family's attention are ignored, he begins to disappear.

1515872.title: Sleepwalker
1515872.overview: Desperate for answers, a troubled sleepwalker returns to his hometown to uncover the truth about his friend’s mysterious disappearance, descending him into the darkest corners of his subconscious.

1535392.title: Malaikat Malam
1535392.overview: Ashraff, a motorcycle workshop owner, balances his daily life activities between caring for his older brother who struggles with depression, participating in illegal street racing, and winning an innocent blind girl's heart.
1535392.trailerName: MALAIKAT MALAM - OFFICIAL TRAILER | DI PAWAGAM 26 MAC 2026

1555232.title: Just a Job
1555232.overview: The film follows a protagonist trapped in a surreal life loop after a scathing boss encounter, using absurdist comedy to satirize modern workplace dynamics.

1559456.title: Finding Harmony: A King's Vision
1559456.overview: In an unprecedented portrait of King Charles III, Finding Harmony: A King's Vision provides intimate insight into His Majesty's passionate quest to reunite humanity with nature. Academy Award-winner Kate Winslet narrates this journey through The King's Foundation's vital work.
cast: King Charles III of the United Kingdom

1559776.title: The A List: 15 Stories from Asian and Pacific Diasporas
1559776.overview: Sandra Oh, Sen. Tammy Duckworth, Kumail Nanjiani, Amanda Nguyen, Connie Chung, and beyond: their worlds may be disparate, but they’ve all, in their unique ways, navigated what it means to be Asian in relation to their American identities. While their success has been fraught with racism, they share their stories of losses and wins.

1560160.title: Love, Sex and Elections
1560160.overview: Martin is a casting agent for adult films. One night in a club, he discovers the perfect candidate for his new role — Dasha, a party girl with remarkable acting potential. After a successful first shoot, however, it turns out that Dasha is the wife of the local mayor. Now Martin must worry not only about his career and life but also about the upcoming election.

1561952.title: Падший
1561952.overview: Geneticist Ivan Rozin, unable to come to terms with the loss of his beloved mother, is obsessively working on a scientific project to find a cure for death and improve the human genome. Violating more and more ethical norms, a scientist absorbed in this idea kidnaps two children. Their mother will have to stop Ivan and prove that his experiments do not lead to perfection, but to the loss of humanity by himself.

1562272.title: Fawnstar
1562272.overview: A horny teenage boy stumbles across a trail cam live feed.

1570976.title: Baahubali: The Eternal War – Part 1
1570976.overview: The murdered Prince Baahubali enters the afterlife and joins an eternal war across 14 realms between Devas and Asuras – personifications of Order and Chaos. His destiny will reshape the cosmos forever.
1570976.trailerName: Baahubali: The Eternal War - Official Trailer (2027)

1574560.title: Last Man in Tower
1574560.overview: Masterji is a retired schoolteacher whose refusal to go along with those around him places him in direct conflict with his own community. His act of quiet resistance ripples outward, throwing into relief the choices and compromises of neighbors – including Mrs. Puri – as an offer of change tests what each of them is willing to hold on to.
1574560.trailerName: Last Man In Tower | TEASER | Manoj Bajpayee, Divya Dutta, Boman Irani | Ben Rekhi | Spirit Media

1575904.title: God Bless You, Mr. Kopu
1575904.overview: A struggling Tongan immigrant is taken under the wing of a charismatic American salesman. What begins as a dream job quickly unravels into a nightmare as the protégé begins questioning his mentor’s methods.

1579168.title: Our Effed Up World
1579168.overview: Sheri thought her biggest problem in life was dealing with the recent loss of her beloved grandma.  But when a mysterious entity crash lands in the woods, only she and her group of shitkicker friends are what stands in the way of an insatiable, intergalactic hunger.

1582304.title: Hanna
1582304.overview: USSR, during the Great Patriotic War. A Russian woman saves a German girl, Hannah, who, thanks to their friendship, learns to survive and maintain hope.

1584032.title: Puppy
1584032.overview: When a woman returns to her childhood home to care for her father, the stuffed animal from her past-once a source of comfort-becomes a haunting conduit for unresolved grief, guilt, and the terrifying possibility that a past family tragedy is repeating itself in the present.

1586016.title: Pain Pain Flies Away Jutsu!
1586016.overview: Sister Winnie, facing a growing-up challenge, and her ninja-aspiring brother Yoyo start a chaotic adventure over a coveted brown sugar candy. When Yoyo tries his ninja trick, things go hilariously wrong. As accidents pile up, he uncovers the truth behind Winnie’s hidden injury—can he save her in time?

1590752.title: Pulang Kampung
1590752.overview: A Batak musical film that will bring the audience's hearts back to their hometown.

1591264.title: Who Killed Artur Falcão?
1591264.overview: On a Christmas Eve that quickly spirals out of control, a group of friends finds themselves embroiled in an unlikely mystery that no one quite knows how to solve. Amid absurd suspicions, embarrassing revelations, and an investigation as improvised as it is chaotic, Christmas Eve dinner transforms into a game of accusations where everyone seems to have something to hide.

1592032.title: Furious Attack
1592032.overview: A former special forces soldier infiltrates northern Myanmar to rescue his missing daughter, fighting against scam gangs and organ traffickers in a final showdown with the crime boss.
1592032.trailerName: Furious Attack (怒袭, 2026) || Trailer || New Chinese Movie

1596320.title: The Brittney Griner Story
1596320.overview: Explores the circumstances that led to Brittney Griner playing basketball outside the U.S. despite being one of the best players in the sport, including her harrowing detainment, unwavering determination to secure her freedom, and her advocacy for the release of other wrongful detainees.

1596448.title: Wraith
1596448.overview: A psychological horror in which a man named Mark wanders a dark, deserted hospital looking for his supposedly dead wife, whose spirit continues to call out to him beyond the halls…

1597280.title: Kenatha Kanom
1597280.overview: Desperate to find water, residents of a parched village start digging a new well, but what they find is not water but a dinosaur fossil.

1598432.title: The Face
1598432.overview: 17-year-old Joel, a recently recruited night guard, watches over a compound marked by cartel violence. When the darkness begins to whisper, he realizes some secrets never die.

1599392.title: Godmother
1599392.overview: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

1599584.title: Saliva Agridoce
1599584.overview: After years of trying to leave behind the traumas that marked their lives, a couple decides to start over in an old house far from the city. Boundaries between memory, guilt, and the supernatural begin to disappear.

1600672.title: EVANGELION 30th Anniversary Special Screening
1600672.overview: A short film celebrating the 30th anniversary of Neon Genesis Evangelion starring both the original and Rebuild iterations of Asuka. The short comedically explores alternate timelines, with Rebuild Asuka helping her original counterpart make some wishes come true.

1603232.title: Perfume - "Cold Sleep" –25 years Document-
1603232.overview: As 2026 heralds the start of technopop group Perfume's 'cold sleep' hiatus, this documentary traces the first 25 years of their career, and is expected to go behind the scenes of their latest album, Nebula Romance, and their latest tours.

1608416.title: The Hero
1608416.overview: At the end of the Great War, a soldier burdened with informing a mother of her son's death, faces an impossible decision... Tell her a noble lie, or the horrible truth?

1611680.title: Mondele
1611680.overview: A Congolese-American teen with dreams of becoming the next Spike Lee races to finish his passion project while balancing cultural expectations, a strict mother, and the weight of immigrant life in Portland, Maine.

1614368.title: Love Go Go Go!
1614368.overview: A spendthrift seeking emotional comfort and a cautious saver searching for security are drawn into an unlikely relationship that begins with constant clashes. As playful tension turns into real feelings, misunderstandings threaten to pull them apart, forcing both to confront what truly matters in love and life.

1617184.title: Amongst Men
1617184.overview: Relatives of Charles Byrne ‘The Irish Giant’ reckon with the legacy of a man both mythologised and misunderstood and the condition that links them still.

1618784.title: Fight Against Evil 3
1618784.overview: Li Hongqi is forced to travel for his wedding but must team up with a local cop to rescue a girl from human traffickers, fighting criminals while racing against his wedding date.

1619488.title: In My Skin
1619488.overview: After a heated discussion between four couples, two teams are formed (girls versus boys) and a crazy game begins. The rules are simple: for a weekend, the girls have to do the boys' activities and vice versa, and each team organizes the other team's weekend in detail. However, what seems like a simple and fun game at the end of the week turns out to be a much more complicated situation.

1621216.title: Narciso
1621216.overview: Narciso is a Black orphan boy living at Carmem’s house until he is adopted. He dreams of having a family, but has had only disappointments so far. To cheer the boy up, his friend, Alexandre gifts him an old basketball, with the promise that, if he scores three baskets, a genie will appear and make his wishes come true.

1622688.title: Baby Udon
1622688.overview: Fanny Kondoh, a young Indonesian woman, falls in love with Hajime Kondoh, a Japanese man who comes to Indonesia for work.  After getting married, Fanny and Hajime begin building a life together, embracing both its joys and challenges. As they struggle to fulfill their dream of having a child, they are faced with one heartbreaking trial after another, testing the strength of their love, especially when Hajime is diagnosed with cancer.
1622688.trailerName: TRAILER | BABY UDON Movie September 3, 2026 IN THEATERS

1624096.title: Our Dead Husband
1624096.overview: Graphic design firm owner Kris is devastated when she discovers her husband, Ritchie, shot dead in their home. She assumes it has to do with Ritchie's work in high-level intelligence. But as Kris prepares for the funeral, she learns that Ritchie's stories about his missions were a cover for a secret family a few hours away. When police begin to suspect Kris for the murder and an attempt is made on her life, she must overcome her distrust of Ritchie's other wife to find out who killed him—and who is now trying to kill her.

1626144.title: When Heaven Inched Towards Earth
1626144.overview: In a Catholic high school in Bulacan, a farm boy’s bond with a sacristan forces him to grapple with faith, shame, and the space between heaven and earth.

1628448.title: Maa Behen
1628448.overview: In this dark comedy, a woman calls her estranged daughters in the middle of the night with chilling news — there's a dead body in her kitchen.
1628448.trailerName: Maa Behen Trailer | Madhuri Dixit, Triptii Dimri, Ravi Kishan, Dharna Durga| Maa Behen Movie Trailer

1633056.title: All Wishes Come True!
1633056.overview: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.

1635552.title: Something Borrowed
1635552.overview: On the morning of her wedding, a bride does anything it takes to fit into her wedding dress.

1637152.title: We Shall Live Together
1637152.overview: Roko Markovina, a former socialist and unionist politician from the city of Mostar in Herzegovina, reflects on the situation in Croatia and Bosnia during wartime and about the fruitless efforts that he and his wife went through to get back their home that had been taken away from them by nationalist forces who exiled them from it.

1637920.title: The Cactus
1637920.overview: As Trysdale prepared for the year-end international exchange formal with Odessey and Malvous in a quiet afternoon, his thoughts drifted to an exchange student named Hecate when he once again locked eyes with the cactus she gave to him, whose fleeting connection with him had dissolved into quiet regret, or maybe there's still a glimpse of chance?
1637920.trailerName: Trailer | The Cactus | 2025 | David Crocpsy Li

1647008.title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
1647008.overview: On the morning of his hundredth birthday, Fanny finds her grandfather dead in his bed. As she and her family are forced to deal with the death, a bitter dispute over the inheritance erupts, in which old power relations are reversed.

1649248.title: Finding Satoshi
1649248.overview: At the center of Bitcoin lies the greatest unsolved mystery of the digital age. Who created it, and who is Satoshi Nakamoto? Finding Satoshi presents the conclusion reached after a four-year, evidence-based investigation, drawing on original reporting and rare access to key figures in crypto to uncover the human ideas, motivations, and philosophy behind the code that reshaped global finance.

1650016.title: Same Sun - Mit dem Fahrrad durch Afrika
1650016.overview: The film SAME SUN tells the story of Wiebke Lühmann's journey from Freiburg to the Cape of Good Hope. Honest, raw, and close to the inner and outer challenges of a 430-day bicycle trip. Her journey takes her through 22 countries, Sahara storms, the rain season, the Congo Basin, and the deserts of Namibia.
1650016.original_title: Same Sun - Mit dem Fahrrad durch Afrika

1651744.title: Arachnobody
1651744.overview: Arachnobody is a symbolically colored short film about a character who suddenly falls ill and isolates himself. Seeking to return to normal life, he turns to a doctor whose help comes at a cost, reflecting a society where kindness is often given only when there's something to gain.

1652192.title: Finding Faith
1652192.overview: A short film contextualising the cultural significance of George Michael's Faith Tour via unheard interview voice-over, unseen images by Herb Ritts, and behind-the-scenes footage of the Faith music video.

1652448.title: Memoona and Sheralam
1652448.overview: Set in a 1900s Pashtun village, this tragic short film follows the lives of Sher Alam and Memoona, whose marriage is rooted in a long-standing childhood promise. While their life begins with quiet affection, the peace is shattered by the poison of jealousy and local rumors.  When an innocent interaction is twisted into a scandal by a resentful friend, Sher Alam is consumed by suspicion and the crushing pressure of social "honor". His inability to trust leads to a final, devastating decision that destroys their lives and leaves a haunting legacy in the mountains

1653600.title: School of Magical Animals 5
1653600.overview: The students are having a school dance in Winterstein. Finja is glad that Sydney the koala is looking after her younger siblings. Outsider Zack revealed the secret of the magical animals to a stranger online - and now he’s been given Zeki the porcupine. Will the class manage to catch the animal thief together?

1654880.title: Alexandria, Mon Amour
1654880.overview: After locking eyes with a striking stranger in an art museum, a disillusioned romantic spots her everywhere he goes across the city, driving him to finally break the silence before she vanishes into the crowd forever.

1655904.title: Bulgakov. The Secret of The Master
1655904.overview: "Bulgakov. The Secret of the Master" examines a mystical connection that proves to be stronger than the author's original vision. The film shows how the immortal novel stopped being an author's text and began to dictate its will to the creator, interfering with his love, relationship with the authorities, and even bringing his fateful end closer. The viewer will see how fiction inexplicably turned into reality, and how the book's prophecies materialized in Bulgakov's own life, prompting the question: who really held the pen – the man or his immortal creation?

1656480.title: The Mask One: Faceless
1656480.overview: A troubled medium joins a crew of ghost-hunting con artists, but when the isolated jungle they investigate begins claiming victims through face-erasing murders, she must reveal her genuine gift or become the ancient entity’s next target.

1657504.title: Rhapsody, Rhapsody
1657504.overview: When Mikio Natsuno obtains a residency certificate, he is stunned to find the name of a woman he has never met listed as his wife. Apparently, he has been "married" for six months without knowing it. Who on earth is the stranger who decided to become his wife? After a frantic search, Mikio finally discovers her—an eccentric young woman with a striking personality who simply says, "I thought I could keep myself together if I were at least married," oﬀering no further explanation. And so, their uneven, unpredictable relationship slowly begins to take shape.

1658272.title: Happily Ever After
1658272.overview: As one sister prepares for marriage and the other resists every convention it represents, their fragile bond is tested by love, family expectations, and the question of whether happiness can ever truly be chosen.

1659808.title: A Deadline Movie
1659808.overview: A group of college students travel back in time to submit their late assignment

1662432.title: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind the Magic
1662432.overview: Featuring interviews from members of the casting, production design, costume design, and creature effects teams, follow the behind-the-scenes journey of bringing the Harry Potter books to the small screen. Find out how the new Golden Trio were found, and celebrate the commitment to detail of the artists, craftspeople, and technicians who have come together to bring the wizarding world to life.

1666464.title: The Hallowed
1666464.overview: The mysterious death of a family patriarch during Holy Week forces his three estranged granddaughters to return to their ancestral home, where their simmering resentments explode just as a vengeful supernatural presence—anchored to a sinister religious statue known as the 13th Apostle—begins to terrorize them, exposing a truth far more terrifying than any ghost.
1666464.trailerName: POON (The Hallowed) (2026) Official Trailer - Ronaldo Valdez, Gina Pareno, Jaclyn Jose, Will Ashley

1673568.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2 Red Carpet World Premiere

Streaming live to subscribers worldwide, the event offers a rare, front‑row view as it unfolds in America’s fashion capital. From red carpet arrivals to behind‑the‑scenes interviews, it’s an inside look at one of the most glamorous nights of the year, and the perfect kickoff to the film’s theatrical debut.

1673888.title: Photo Negative

1680032.title: Gone Part Three

1693984.title: Hill 338

Somewhere in the Great Rift Valley stands a small, forgotten, and seemingly useless military base. When the Chinese government offers the state of Israel an enormous sum of cash to lay the path of their new Silk Road through it, all that seems to be done is to shut this base down. Ran Shem Tov, a "disassembly officer" who was deployed to command due to "military streamlining needs", is recruited for this mission. But the thing Ran and the heads of the IDF don't know is that an old bunker was built beneath the base, for which no one remembers the cause of construction. Lately, strange things have been happening in it, which delay the base's shutdown. These events bring all soldiers together against internal and external forces.

1694176.title: Karina and Faker

1705888.title: Groundskeeper

But when their estranged former best friend shows up, unannounced, with her douche boyfriend in tow… plans change. Tensions rise, friendships are tested, and the whole weekend seems hopeless. As a last-ditch attempt to save the trip, the group revisits a game from their childhood, a game inspired by a local ghost story. What started out as a fun activity turns deadly as real life begins to mirror the actions of the game, leading the friends to question each other and their own judgement. After all, no one really believes in ghosts… right?

1706080.title: The Day I Stopped Walking
1706080.overview: When we stop we're so focused on productivity and efficiency that we feel guilty and confused about our own limitless time giving rise to a silent restlessness: the feeling that we should be producing, moving forward, and justifying every minute. With a new emerging force, the human being in its essence becomes increasingly scarce: we can no longer think, speak, and, above all, be. But ultimately, why does it have to be this way?

1706656.title: The Woods Run Red – The Making of “Hunter’s Blood”

To earn the pilots’ respect and ensure the event can move forward, the drivers and sailors go head-to-head in a series of intense yet entertaining challenges. What follows is a cinematic, high-energy, and unexpectedly authentic journey as the drivers immerse themselves in Navy life.

Through archival footage and present-day reflections, the film portrays a fearless artist and bridge-builder for peace.

Haunted by fractured traumatic memories and visions of a dark-hooded figure, she struggles to hold onto reality as her friend is drawn into the orbit of a dangerous underworld. As her world unravels, she must confront the terrifying truth behind the figure that stalks her, and face the darkness within.

1732640.original_title: Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness
